title: Account-status follow-ups: audit events, atomic role rewrite, keyed lookup, case-variant deny, stable tests, documented scope

criteria.given: the account-status filter refuses a disabled account or demotes an admin
criteria.then: an audit event is emitted for each (account_refused, account_demoted)
the delete-then-insert runs in one transaction, so a concurrent lookup never sees a half-written role set

criteria.given: the status lookup runs, or two rows differ only by case
criteria.then: a keyed query is used (not a scan of every user) and the account is denied if any case-variant row is disabled

criteria.given: the policy cache TTL and its tests
criteria.then: the TTL uses a monotonic clock that tests inject, the DAO test cannot skip via assumeTrue, and the unreferenced authorisationPredicate bean is gone
it states the re-enable path, the roles and authentication types covered, the delete/rename caveat and the upgrade recovery step
